name: Dragon’s Breath
summary: Lets a willing creature exhale a 15-foot Cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

stats.effect: You touch one willing creature, and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Until the spell ends, the target can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action to exhale a 15-foot {ref:glossary/cone}. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
